quote: To work in silence and with all one’s heart, that is the writer’s lot; he is the only artist who must be a solitary, and yet needs the widest outlook upon the world.
source: Sarah Orne Jewett, Letters of Sarah Orne Jewett, to Willa Cather, 13 December 1908, p. 250 (ed. Annie Fields, 1911)
